scripts.firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist-firefox --start-url http://127.0.0.1:5174
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist-firefox
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env node_modules/web-ext/bin/web-ext.js sign --source-dir dist-firefox --artifacts-dir web-ext-artifacts --channel unlisted
